title: Map, Filter, Reduce
hints: These are the functions_02 exercise again, but generic: T is the element type, and U (for Map) or A (for Reduce) is a second type parameter for the result.
Reduce starts from init and folds each element in: acc = f(acc, x). Don't skip init, and don't modify the input slice in any of the three.
Map: out := make([]U, 0, len(xs)); append f(x). Filter: append x when keep(x). Reduce: acc := init; for _, x := range xs { acc = f(acc, x) }; return acc.
